verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a BSD-2 open-source, pip-installable, self-hostable framework, and its docs say the same bot file is portable across the dev runner, Pipecat Cloud and most self-hosting setups, so users can take their agent code and leave. No documented export of Pipecat Cloud-held data (agents, secrets, builds, session or org data) in open formats exists; the audio-recording and transcript processors are developer building blocks and earn no credit. missing for 10: documented Cloud data export, open export formats for account and session data, an offboarding or account-deletion workflow, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: This is the property that makes the same bot file portable across the development runner, Pipecat Cloud, and most production self-hosting setups.
the open-source voice-agent framework is real, pip-installable, and self-hostable
